BETA Close X RS Group PLC has announced the purchase of 518,800 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £100 million share repurchase program. These purchases occurred between July 6 and July 10, 2026, with the highest price paid per share being 627.50 pence and the lowest at 594.50 pence, resulting in a volume-weighted average price of 609.48 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares will be 471,313,208, with no shares held in treasury, and the total number of voting rights stands at 471,313,208. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 13 July 2026 RS Group plc 13 July 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 6 July 2026 to 10 July 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 471,313,208 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total number of voting rights in the Company is 471,313,208. This announcement is made in accordance with the requirements of UK Listing Rule 9.6.6.
